title: Ye's Dale Earnhart Jr. Hat
description:
Background: This Dale Earnhardt Jr. Hat was worn by Ye throughout November of 2022. Ye had the front duct taped, and the hat features distressing throughout, especially on the brim.

Documented wear by Ye:
• 11/05/2022 in Los Angeles
• 11/13/2022 at Justin LaBoy's birthday bash in Los Angeles
• 11/16/2022 leaving the Waldorf Astoria in Beverly Hills
• 11/18/2022 at the Dentist and entering the Sweetgreen Offices in Los Angeles
• 11/19/2022 at the Sweetgreen Offices in Los Angeles, showing an X17Online employee around
• 11/22/2022 flying to Florida to meet with Donald Trump at Mar-a-Lago
• 11/25/2022 entering Sweetgreen Offices in Los Angeles
• 11/26/2022 at a Church in West Hills, Los Angeles
• 11/27/2022 at a Church in West Hills, Los Angeles, and leaving Giorgio Armani
